entries.instruction: Place this exact red SCRAM lever in a dimly lit retro submarine reactor compartment, mounted on a bottle green enamel wall between riveted pipes, warm lamp light and a faint blue glow, a chubby mustached sailor's hand reaching for it

Place this exact green enamel control console in a retro submarine reactor compartment with riveted bulkheads, brass pipes and warm lamp light, brass gauges mounted on its sloped panel, one chubby mustached sailor reading a huge manual next to it

Place this exact round-wheel hatch door in a submarine bulkhead inside a long corridor, riveted green plates, caged ceiling lamps, a chubby mustached sailor turning the wheel, warm light spilling through the gap
